summary: Shopify Sync System Improvements Testing Complete - All 13 backend tests passed (100%) and all UI features verified. The 5 requested improvements to the Shopify sync system are working: 1) Availability tracking via _is_product_available(), 2) AI re-extraction on description changes via _hash_body() and body_html_hash comparison, 3) Manual product cleanup during sync, 4) Full Re-Import endpoint and UI buttons, 5) Per-product sync status fields (last_synced_at, body_html_hash, available, source).

seed_data_creation: Test sync configs created for DE and IT with test shop URLs (enabled=False). Full reimport jobs triggered which created sync_history entries with type='force_reimport'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 Shopify sync improvements verified: 1) _is_product_available() checks variants[].available, 2) _hash_body() creates MD5 hash of body_html for change detection, 3) _run_import() removes manual products by name match when Shopify product with same name exists, 4) /api/admin/full-reimport/{lang} endpoint triggers full re-import with force_ai=True, 5) Products now have last_synced_at, body_html_hash, available, source fields. The sync history entries now include 'type' field distinguishing between 'sync' and 'force_reimport'. Note: All sync jobs fail with DNS errors because shop URLs are test placeholders (test-shop.example.com) - this is expected behavior.

notes.expected_dns_errors: Sync jobs show status='error' because shop URLs are test placeholders (test-shop.example.com). This is expected and correct - the endpoints work, but actual Shopify fetching fails due to invalid URLs.
notes.shopify_sync_fields: Products now include: last_synced_at (ISO timestamp), body_html_hash (MD5 hash for change detection), available (boolean from variants), source ('shopify' for imported products)
